about: Sprite-family art bindings, read by UDinkArtFamilySubsystem at screen activation and by Scripts/art_coverage.py. Visual only: placements keep their collision, hardness, origin IDs and scripts. Precedence: origin and screen bindings in the other Data/Art manifests win; a class id row wins over a sequence row. fit none (the default): real-size meshes standing at the card's ground point, like the player and the dressed screens. Rules: SourceAssets/Art/ART_STANDARD.md.

families.note: 173 bonuses/barrels/barel- frame 1. Kit barrel (library Oak + WroughtIron), not the photoreal V1 (16,648 tris, private material). Scripted barrels included: their scripts hold pickups, the barrel stays a barrel. barrel_broken stays unbound.
64 inside/details/inacc- frame 3. Scripted beds are the sleep/save beds; the bed stays a bed.
87 inside/details/table- frames 3 and 5. table_round, benches, cabinets and posts stay unbound: the oak table's rectangle would change their silhouette.
461 inner/chair- frames 1-4, 7, 8 (one facing per frame; the mesh takes a stable per-origin yaw for all). Stools stay unbound: a chair back would add to the silhouette.
32 lands/trees/tree- frame 1. The pine screen 471 and the vista use. Scripted pines (burnable secrets, the talking tree) keep their cards so they can get a visibly dry tree (plan section 3).
32 lands/trees/tree-. Stand-in broadleaf until the willow (SourceAssets/Art/Stonebrook/Refinements/SharedStonebrookVistaV1/PhotorealWillowV1, source only) is imported; rebind then.
32 lands/trees/tree-. Stand-in, as tree_willow_large. Dead trees, stumps and the forest-edge strips stay unbound: a leafy single oak would read wrong.
95 lands/rocks/rock-. Scripted (bombable) rocks keep their cards so they can get a visibly cracked rock (plan section 3).
95 lands/rocks/rock-. Grey fieldstone for a reddish boulder: shape right, colour not; rebind when a red-stone material exists in the library.
95 lands/rocks/rock-. The pair of white boulders and the blue ore rock stay unbound.
97 lands/rocks/rocks-. Pebbles (214) stay unbound: a boulder where the sprite is walk-over scatter would read as an obstacle that does not block.
65 lands/grass/grass- frame 2. Ferns, flowers and the bushes (179) stay unbound: a grass clump is not their shape.

93 lands/fence/fence- frame 1 (east-west run; with yaw_from_sprite off a run takes a stable per-origin yaw, set it true to align runs east-west). North-south and diagonal runs stay unbound: their sprite is a projected depth that a uniform scale cannot fit.
